note: The Financial Consumer Agency of Canada names the two main credit bureaus, Equifax and TransUnion, and gives up to six years for late or unpaid credit cards and loans; Equifax's sample report, as Quebec's consumer protection office publishes it, says information is received every 30 days from most credit grantors, so a missed payment is reported at the next monthly reporting, written as 30 days. The agency's pages refuse this environment's egress and were read through the web fetcher.
